**Job Description**

**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

Department overview

  

S&P Global, EBS is specialist provider of managed and installed data services, delivering world-class data, technology and service solutions focusing on the complex and evolving Index and ETF data needs. Used in the front, middle and back office by the world’s leading Investment Banks, Asset Managers, Fund Administrators, Prime Brokers and Hedge Funds.

  

Position summary

  

The successful candidate will play a key part in maintaining the smooth running of the day-to-day operations of EBS data offering and working with cross functional teams to identify solutions in problem areas to remove operational inefficiencies. On the data enhancement aspect, the candidate will use advanced Excel, VBA and SQL skills translating operational requirements into technical solutions and tools. The team operates 24/7, thus interested candidates will be required to work in all shifts including US hours.

  

Duties & accountabilities

  

* New hire needs to be well versed with Index and ETF concepts and their calculations.
* Validate the accuracy of data received from various sources. Ensure that this information is stored in databases and is accurately reflected on products by creating or running data quality checks and standards.
* Ensure the quality and time-efficient production of financial information to respective products.
* Respond to data queries from both internal and external clients and provide support to stakeholders.
* Monitor and research market events in order to anticipate changes. Ensure a deep understanding of the markets and business events.
* Work with and involve cross functional teams to provide Root Cause Analysis to identify solutions in problem areas.
* Consolidate information around the dataset leading to the establishment of best practices.
* Perform automated/semi-automated checks to ensure production of high quality content.
* Ensure MOW’s are documented and maintained.
* Coordinate and Delegate work as per team requirements
* Identify data quality improvement projects, and good design practices
* Intermediate Excel and SQL skills, including being able to write basic SQL queries.
* Proven ability to utilize data and systems tools available
* Good verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  

**Education and experience**

  

* The candidate should have a good understanding of equities & capital markets. Specific knowledge around Index/ETF and Corporate Actions highly preferred.
* 0-2 years of business operations experience and must be flexible in addressing dynamic business needs.
  

**Commercial awareness :**

  

Must have a strong interest in finance and be up to date with current global financial market news.

  

**Management requirements : NA**

  

Personal competencies

  

**Personal impact :**

  

The candidate must be a self-starter, able to take on multiple tasks at a time, hardworking, and efficient.

  

**Communication :**

  
  

Must demonstrate superior communication skills and is expected to interact professionally across business units within the company.

  

**Teamwork :**

  

Being a team player is a vital aspect of the position, and it is expected that the candidate will work well individually, as well as in a global team environment

  
  

**About S&P Global Market Intelligence**
  
  
At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction.
  
  
For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence.

**What’s In It For** **You?**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

  

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
Our benefits include:

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

title: Operations Associate
description:
**About JONE**   
JONE is a fast growing, independent UK/USA fashion brand that works with artisans, suppliers and tailors to give ancient textiles a contemporary form. We’re looking for an organized, hands-on person in Bangalore to work closely with JONE’s founder and help take our pieces from production through to the customer. The role You’ll be JONE’s person on the ground, working closely with the founder to turn ideas into finished pieces and get them into customers’ hands. One day you might be visiting a supplier or checking a sample, the next, coordinating a tailor, preparing orders or helping bring a campaign shoot to life. It’s a hands-on role with real ownership. You’ll thrive if you love beautiful clothes, build good relationships, spot the details others miss and know how to keep things moving when plans change.

**What you’ll do**  
Coordinate suppliers: Work with JONE’s founder to place orders, follow up on deliveries, track timelines and resolve issues.  
Manage tailoring: Share specifications, monitor production and check that pieces are finished on time and to standard.  
Check and pack orders: Inspect finished products for quality and accuracy, then pack customer orders with care and ship to our USA warehouse.  
Support campaign shoots: Coordinate schedules, people, locations and logistics before and during shoots.

**What you’ll need**  
Excellent written and spoken English  
Strong organization and the ability to manage several moving tasks  
A careful eye for quality and detail  
Confident communication with suppliers, tailors and creative teams  
Reliability, initiative and a practical approach to solving problems

**Nice to have:** Telugu; experience in retail, fashion production, or fulfilment.

description:
**J O B D E S C R I P T I O N**

**Business Development Executive** - *Campus Partnerships* (College Outreach)

Alternative titles: Campus Partnership Executive · College Relationship Executive · Institutional Sales Executive (Education) · Campus Connect Executive

**Department**

Business Development / Sales

**Location / Territory**

Bangalore & Karnataka

**Employment type**

Full-time, on-site / **Field (B2B)**

**Reports to**

Business Development Manager / Founder

**Experience**

0–3 years (freshers with strong sales aptitude considered for a junior band)

Role Summary

We are looking for a field-driven Business Development Executive to build and own partnerships with colleges. You will approach college placement cells (TPOs), HODs, and principals, establish formal tie-ups, coordinate on-campus assessment exams, and drive student enrollment into our internship programs — both our merit-based free internships (for exam qualifiers) and our paid internship programs. This is a target-oriented role suited to someone who enjoys travel, relationship-building, and closing.

Key Responsibilities

**College Tie-ups & Relationships**

* Identify, map, and prioritize target colleges within the assigned territory.
* Visit campuses to pitch our internship programs to Training & Placement Officers (TPOs), placement coordinators, HODs, and faculty.
* Negotiate and formalize partnerships / MoUs with colleges and maintain long-term relationships.

**On-campus Assessments**

* Coordinate and conduct assessment exams on campus for the merit-based (free) internship track — scheduling, logistics, invigilation support, and result coordination with the internal team.
* Ensure smooth execution of seminars, orientation sessions, and info-drives around the exams.

**Student Enrollment & Revenue**

* Explain the two tracks clearly to students: free internships for exam qualifiers, and paid internship enrollment for other interested students.
* Drive paid internship enrollments and achieve monthly enrollment and revenue targets.
* Manage the full funnel from campus visit → assessment → enrollment → handover to the program team.

**Reporting & Coordination**

* Submit daily / weekly visit reports and maintain accurate records in CRM.
* Track pipeline (colleges approached, tie-ups signed, exams conducted, students enrolled) and report performance.
* Coordinate with internal marketing, operations, and program teams for campus activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new college tie-ups / MoUs signed per month
* Number of campuses visited and assessments conducted
* Number of students enrolled (free + paid track)
* Revenue generated from paid internships
* Pipeline health and reporting discipline

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (MBA / BBA in Sales or Marketing is a plus).
* 1–3 years in business development, institutional / education sales, field sales, or campus outreach. *(Freshers with strong communication and a sales drive may be considered for a junior / trainee band.)*
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills; **fluency in Kannada is essential** for building rapport with local colleges and students, along with working English.
* Familiarity with the Rayalaseema region (Anantapur / Kurnool / Chittoor and nearby districts) and its colleges is a strong advantage.
* Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, able to work independently in the field.
* Comfortable with extensive travel across multiple districts , including overnight stays when required; **own two-wheeler with valid license required.**
* Basic proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

* Field sales: 1 year (Preferred)
